v1_results.note: 10 AI clusters only, 23.9% unmatched = 社科待聚类

v2_results.note: 66 clusters (10 AI + 56 社科). 98.3% coverage but tag-layer dedup needed; c_34 dominants at 93% due to shared 社科 tags across clusters.

v5_results.note: SRO-level keyword matching (proposition-local), 91.1% coverage. 64 of 66 clusters hit. c_03 is AI-domain cluster, v5 input is社科-only (304 sources) — zero hit is expected. c_54 is a minor社科 cluster (3 original propositions, narrow tag pool) — zero hit flagged for audit, not necessarily an error. Field compatibility normalizer applied.

v6_results.note: Active clusters: 62 (c_03/c_15/c_20/c_54 已移至 consensus_clusters_archive.json). c_57(公关策略上策) 185 hits (#1) after c_15/c_20 merge. c_54 标签修正后 0→3 hits. c_03 is AI-domain, zero hit in社科-only pool is expected. Pipeline: normalize_clusters() no longer needs status=merged skip — archive separation makes it impossible for merged clusters to participate.

evolution.opposition_note: 70 对均来自 AI 簇（c_01:21, c_02:13, c_09:36），gap 0.252-0.349。BGE 检出同话题（>0.55），Qwen3 检出立场差异（<0.30），但实为不同来源的不同命题共享关键词，非真正对立。社科簇（c_11-c_66）无对立对。
